evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

leaf_kind: annotation / classification metadata, not a game-derived scalar
adjudicability_note: The new value was supplied to me as a schema placeholder, not as concrete map contents. No literal disposition/view_tag map is quotable from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md, so I cannot check entry-by-entry equality. What I can and did adjudicate independently: (a) whether the leaf's existence contradicts any wiki-derived number, (b) whether the priced-vs-documented taxonomy the leaf encodes is grounded in the permitted sources, and (c) which dispositions the cached wiki text forces for this specific scenario at 120 splinters.

step_1_what_the_scenario_is.claim: 'syndra_derived_order_120' is Syndra at 120 Splinters of Wrath — the maximum stack count, at which every Transcendent threshold is simultaneously active.
step_1_what_the_scenario_is.wiki_basis: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities: P 'stacking up to 120 times'; thresholds at 40 (Q charge), 60 (W true damage), 80 (E scatter/slow), 100 (R execute), 120 (+15% ability power).

step_2_the_derived_order_the_name_points.rule_from_wiki: P Transcendent: 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.' The buff multiplies ABILITY POWER (a derived stat), not ability DAMAGE.
step_2_the_derived_order_the_name_points.consequence: Every '% AP' ratio must read post-buff AP, and every flat base must NOT be scaled. Order matters and is observable.

worked_example_Q_rank5_at_A_eq_400_AP.wiki_row: Q Dark Sphere, Magic Damage = [90,125,160,195,230] + 70% AP
worked_example_Q_rank5_at_A_eq_400_AP.delta: 34.5 (6.25% overstatement) — the flat 230 base must not inherit the 15%

worked_example_R_rank3_per_sphere_at_A_e.wiki_row: R Unleashed Power, Magic Damage per Sphere = [80,120,160] + 20% AP

step_3_dispositions_the_wiki_forces_at_1.note: At 120 splinters all five thresholds fire at once, and the cached wiki text splits them into three distinct kinds. A scenario that fires all of them simultaneously is precisely the one where a single blended damage number cannot tell you which terms were priced. That is the gap the new leaf closes.

terms.term: Q Dark Sphere magic damage, W Force of Will magic damage, E Scatter the Weak magic damage, R Unleashed Power magic damage per sphere
terms.wiki: explicit 'Magic Damage' leveling rows in data/champions.json
'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.'
terms.required_disposition: priced / modeled, but on the true-damage path — must bypass resistances entirely (CLAUDE.md domain rule: 'True damage ignores all resistances')
terms.caveat: This row's cached modifier units are degraded ('  2' instead of a real unit), so the numeric row is a known-degraded parse; the disposition (true, not magic) is unambiguous from the description text.

terms.required_disposition: buff on a derived stat — not a damage leaf; it must appear upstream of every '% AP' ratio (see step_2)

terms.term: E 80-splinter enhancement (increased scatter angle, 70% slow for 1.25 s)
terms.wiki: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70%'
terms.required_disposition: out of scope / utility — carries no damage term at all

terms.wiki: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.'
terms.doc_basis: docs/math-foundations.md Section 1.3: 'The engine prices the threshold as a display row and does *not* add execute damage to totals ... the kill boundary is documented, not double-counted. This is the conservative choice: an execute is an absorbing event, not a damage instance.'

independent_computation.step_4_why_absent_is_the_worse_state: The scenario's whole point is that five heterogeneous effects fire at one stack count, one of which (R execute) is deliberately unpriced and one of which (P AP buff) is not a damage leaf at all. With only numeric leaves, the golden gate can tell you a number moved but not that a term crossed from 'documented' to 'priced' — exactly the silent-regression class CLAUDE.md rule 5 was written against (the 3x Statikk Shiv overstatement hidden by a silent fallback). Recording {disposition, view_tag} per leaf makes that crossing a visible diff. Nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md contradicts adding it, and it perturbs no wiki-derived number.
independent_computation.conclusion: The transition <absent> -> <dispositions map> is correct in kind and correctly motivated by the cached wiki text for this scenario. I could not verify literal map contents (not derivable from the permitted sources); I verified that the taxonomy is grounded and that the five wiki-forced dispositions above are the ones any correct map must encode.

sources_quoted.quote: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
Magic Damage: [90, 125, 160, 195, 230] + [70]% AP; 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70% for 1.25 seconds...

Magic Damage per Sphere: [80, 120, 160] + [20]% AP. 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.'

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 1.3 (Order statistics, quantiles and hitting times for executes)
sources_quoted.quote: The engine prices the threshold as a display row and does *not* add execute damage to totals (`_add_execute_display`) — the kill boundary is documented, not double-counted. This is the conservative choice: an execute is an absorbing event, not a damage instance.
**EXACT** = instantiates the identity exactly under the deterministic model; **APPROX** = documented approximation (never silently presented as exact).

"out_of_scope": ["E/W CC (stun, knockback, slow - utility only)", "R 100-splinter execute (documented not modeled)"] ... "P = 120-splinter +15% total AP BUFF." ... "The one damage.execute atom (R at 100 splinters, kills below 15% max HP) is explicitly documented as not modeled ('the fight target never dies') in ASSUMPTIONS."

"E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers."
